papers.title_en: Toward the Era of Agentic Embodied Intelligence
papers.authors: Chao Liang, Ke Chen, Fengxiaoxiao Li, Shibo Huang, Yufeng Sun, Zhaokai Yin, Jianhuan Lai, Haozhe Feng, Chenghuan Jia, Zhipeng Zhang
papers.evidence: 具身多智能体框架与潜在世界模型
papers.tldr: 基础模型虽能引导机器人动作，但长程任务仍受控制效率低、失败恢复弱和部署适应性不足限制。论文提出以代码为扩展接口的A2-MEAS，多智能体协同学习融合语言纠错、空间证据、执行历史与动作提议，并以A2-WLA增强动作策略。在BEHAVIOR 2026全部100项公开任务上取得0.6411 Q分数和45.40%成功率，真实家居任务平均成功率达57.92%，同时显著提升失败后恢复效果。研究展示了高效训练、冻结权重在线适配和可扩展具身智能系统的潜力。
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models increasingly guide robot actions, yet sustained autonomy requires efficient control and failure recovery. We introduce A2-MEAS, an embodied multi-agent framework built around code as a scaling interface. Learned correction codes combine corrective language, spatial evidence, execution history, and action proposals. MetaBrain provides training supervision and runtime guidance. A correction encoder and adapter absorb this knowledge into policy weights during training, while fresh codes adapt behavior with frozen weights at deployment. The action model, A2-WLA, adds motion-aware history and a latent world model to a vision-language-action policy. Surprisingly, this simple design with action pretraining and task specialization reaches 0.5755 Q-score on the 50-task BEHAVIOR 2026 public subset before online correction, 2.21x the 2025 winner's reported 0.2605 across different benchmark editions and training configurations. On all 100 BEHAVIOR 2026 public tasks, A2-MEAS achieves 0.6411 Q-score and 45.40% task success. On RoboTwin 2.0, A2-WLA achieves 93.98% average success, rising to 95.05% with the complete system. Across 12 real-robot tasks in five household settings, A2-WLA achieves 57.92% average success versus 26.67% for pi0.5. In long-horizon pour-over coffee preparation, a history-conditioned adapter raises post-failure completion at two filter-handling steps from 14% to 94% and from 8% to 82%, compared with A2-WLA retries. Our training infrastructure delivers 427.1 samples per second, 4.03x the throughput of a pi0.5 reference implementation on matched hardware. We will release the system, models, training scripts, and infrastructure to support efficient embodied learning.

papers.title_en: HSGNav: Hypothesis Scene Graphs for Multi-Scale Lifelong Navigation under Object Relocation
papers.authors: Kaiyao Liao, Qingfeng Li, Chen Chen, Qing Sun, Ningbo Gu, Xiaoze Wu, Haochen Zhao, Ying Li, Jianwei Niu
papers.evidence: 利用可更新的多尺度三维场景假设实现终身机器人导航
papers.tldr: 现实家庭中，机器人需要在大尺度家具与小型桌面物品间反复寻找目标，而物品搬移会使传统三维记忆产生过期记录。HSGNav提出假设场景图，将稳定家具实体与可修订的表面物体假设分离，保留视觉证据并支持局部更新。系统按目标尺度检索、探索补充观测，并通过验证确认目标或失效矛盾记录。实验显示其在GOAT-Bench上具竞争力，并在新建FAROS-Bench上显著优于既有方法，推动多尺度终身导航走向更可靠的记忆管理。
papers.abstract_en: In real homes, assistive robots must repeatedly locate targets from large furniture to tiny tabletop items, as people move objects between household surfaces. Uniformly instantiating detections at different scales as 3D objects can be brittle for small on-surface items; without explicit object-state validation, stale entries may persist after scene changes. Our key insight is to separate persistent 3D furniture entities from revisable surface-object hypotheses, retaining their visual evidence without requiring independent object geometry. We formalize this design as the Hypothesis Scene Graph (HSG), which preserves small-object evidence and supports local revision without rebuilding the stable entity topology. Building on HSG, HSGNav uses this separation for multi-scale lifelong navigation: retrieval selects entity or hypothesis evidence according to target scale, exploration acquires additional surface observations, and verification confirms target presence or invalidates contradicted hypothesis records. Because existing lifelong benchmarks such as GOAT-Bench rarely require mid-episode memory invalidation or multi-scale search, we introduce FAROS-Bench (Find And Re-find Objects across Scales) for mid-episode relocation of surface objects and multi-scale find goals. Experiments show that HSGNav performs competitively on GOAT-Bench while substantially outperforming prior methods on FAROS-Bench.

papers.title_en: 3R-Adapter: Retrieval, Rewiring, and Refinement for Efficient Adaptation of 3D Reconstruction Model
papers.authors: Zixiang Ai, Zhenyu Cui, Xu Zou, Jiahuan Zhou
papers.evidence: 前馈三维重建模型的高效适配
papers.tldr: 大规模预训练的前馈式三维重建模型虽具良好泛化能力，却在低光照、人与场景联合重建及测试时适应等长尾场景中出现跨视角对应失败，表现为关系注意力结构坍塌。3R-Adapter将模型适应视为域偏移下的对应关系恢复，并以轻量参数高效微调显式改造关系结构。方法通过可变形检索、关系重连和一致性细化，逐步检索候选关系、重建跨视角联系并注入稳定预测。多项实验表明，其在上述任务中较现有参数高效方法更稳健，同时保持高效适应，为三维重建长尾泛化提供了实用方案。
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models have demonstrated strong generalization under large-scale pre-training, yet they struggle in long-tail scenarios such as low-light reconstruction, joint human-scene reconstruction, and test-time adaptation. We observe relational attention structure collapse, manifested as the failure of cross-view correspondences, as a primary cause of these limitations. While adaptation offers a practical way to bridge this gap, existing parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) approaches mainly perform channel-wise feature adjustment and lack mechanisms to explicitly adapt relational structures, leaving correspondence failures unresolved. In this work, we formulate adaptation of 3D reconstruction models as a problem of correspondence recovery under domain shift and propose 3R-Adapter, a PEFT paradigm for long-tail 3D reconstruction scenarios. Our method consists of three components: Deformable Retrieval for task-adaptive relation candidate retrieval, Relational Rewiring for reconstructing cross-view relational structures, and Consistency Refinement for injecting the rewired relations into stable predictions. Extensive experiments on low-light reconstruction, joint human-scene reconstruction, and test-time adaptation demonstrate that our approach significantly improves robustness over existing PEFT methods while maintaining efficient lightweight adaptation. Our code is released at https://github.com/PKU-OV3-LAB/3R-Adapter.

papers.title_en: HIST3R: Decomposing and Rectifying State Updates with History for Streaming 3D Reconstruction
papers.authors: Kenneth Yang, Yu-Chiang Frank Wang
papers.evidence: 直接改进CUT3R式流式三维重建
papers.tldr: 流式三维重建依赖受限内存中的循环状态，错误更新会覆盖历史信息并造成长时域几何漂移。HIST3R在CUT3R基础上利用历史状态，同时校正更新方向并调节更新幅度：依据局部一致历史修正几何意图，依据当前观测与历史的视觉差异抑制冗余写入、保留互补证据。在相机位姿、三维重建和视频深度任务上，它以不增加内存与推理开销为代价显著提升长视频性能，千帧场景下ATE最高降低33.65%，重建精度最高提升56.52%。该方法解决了仅控制更新强度而无法纠正方向的局限。
papers.abstract_en: Streaming 3D reconstruction with recurrent states enables long-video scene understanding under bounded memory, but turns reconstruction into a state-evolution problem: each incoming frame updates a compact scene memory on which all subsequent predictions depend, so unreliable updates overwrite historical context and accumulate into long-horizon geometric drift. We analyze CUT3R-style recurrent updates through a direction--magnitude decomposition, in which the magnitude sets the update gain, i.e., how strongly an observation is written into the state, and the direction encodes the geometric intent, i.e., where the update drives the state. This decomposition provides a unified view of CUT3R and its variants, revealing that existing training-free extensions perform magnitude-only control: they can attenuate an unreliable update but cannot correct its direction. We propose HIST3R, a training-free framework built on CUT3R that controls both components using history. HIST3R rectifies the update direction using locally consistent historical states, and modulates the update magnitude according to the visual discrepancy between the current observation and its history, suppressing redundant updates while preserving complementary evidence. Across camera pose estimation, 3D reconstruction, and video depth estimation, HIST3R consistently improves long-horizon performance while retaining the memory footprint and inference speed of CUT3R. With 1000 input frames, it reduces ATE by 23.87% on ScanNet and 33.65% on TUM-Dynamics relative to the strongest competing method; with 500 frames, it improves median reconstruction accuracy over the strongest CUT3R-based variant by 56.52% on 7-Scenes and 33.96% on NRGBD.

papers.title_en: ActPrune: Action-Grounded Visual Token Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.authors: Sungwon Moon, Minji Kim, Hyemin Boo, Daeun Song, Jiyoung Lee
papers.evidence: 面向闭环视觉语言动作机器人操作的动作感知加速
papers.tldr: 视觉语言动作模型用于机器人闭环操作，但完整处理观测中的视觉标记会带来较高推理成本，影响响应速度。ActPrune利用上一控制步已预测的动作块，在视觉编码前依据机器人动作建立几何先验并裁剪视觉标记。它在固定第三人称视角保留末端执行器轨迹和语义锚点，在腕部视角去除运动补偿后保持不变的区域。实验显示最高加速1.61倍、减少59.5%浮点运算，成功率几乎不降，提升了高效控制能力。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models perform versatile manipulation tasks from language instructions, but their inference cost limits how fast a robot can respond in closed-loop control. Visual token pruning reduces this cost; however, prior methods estimate token redundancy from encoded visual embeddings or attention, only after the visual encoder has processed the entire observation. We propose \ours, a training-free token pruning method that moves the pruning decision ahead of the vision encoder by grounding it in a geometric prior derived from the robot's own action. The action chunk predicted at the previous control step is already available before the current observation is encoded, and it specifies the end-effector and camera motion between consecutive observations. The same action affects the two standard camera views asymmetrically: in the fixed third-person view, \ours retains patches along the projected end-effector trajectory together with semantic anchors, while in the wrist view, it prunes patches that remain unchanged after compensating for the action-induced camera motion. Extensive experiments on two simulation environments (LIBERO and VLABench) and four real-robot tasks demonstrate that \ours achieves up to 1.61 $\times$ speedup and 59.5\% FLOPs reduction with negligible degradation in success rates.

papers.title_en: STRIDE: Learning Humanoid Locomotion in Minutes with Acceleration-Based Rewards
papers.authors: Nico Bohlinger, Jan Peters
papers.evidence: 面向人形机器人运动导航的强化学习
papers.tldr: 人形机器人直接在真机上学习行走有望缩小仿真到现实差距，但传统奖励依赖难以由机载系统可靠测量的基座速度。STRIDE改用仅需IMU的加速度奖励，要求机器人跟踪指令加速度，并结合XQC、高增益关节位置控制与左右对称增强提升样本效率。在Unitree G1和Booster T1仿真中，约14分钟样本即可学会行走，训练跌倒次数较未采用相关组件的方法减少81%。该方法表明，仅凭机载传感器也能快速学习人形行走，为真机强化学习提供更实用的路径。
papers.abstract_en: Learning locomotion directly on a humanoid robot is a promising direction to avoid the sim-to-real gap. However, locomotion rewards in Reinforcement Learning (RL) typically track the base velocity, which cannot be measured onboard without an external motion capture system or well-calibrated state estimator. This is why we introduce \method{}, which learns humanoid locomotion from minutes of samples with a reward that only requires the onboard Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU). Instead of tracking the base velocity, STRIDE rewards the robot for following a commanded acceleration profile. To learn efficiently from this reward, we use the off-policy RL algorithm XQC and combine a high gain setting for the joint position controllers with left-right symmetry augmentation. In simulation, STRIDE learns to walk on the Unitree G1 and Booster T1 humanoids within 14 minutes of samples. Compared to learning without these two components, it reduces the falls during training by 81%, while without them the robot learns only in over an hour.

papers.title_en: HOC2R: Hand-Object Contact Trajectories for Human-to-Robot Motion Transfer
papers.authors: Hongkun Yu, Francisco M. López, Francisco Cruz
papers.evidence: 用于将人类操作示范迁移到机器人的手物接触定位
papers.tldr: 人类视频蕴含丰富的物体操作示范，但难以直接转化为机器人可执行的运动线索。HOC2R结合冻结的DINOv3与SAM 2.1特征，学习手物关联和接触定位，提取接触轨迹。其在30项基准上将接触计数准确率由58.1%提升至71.4%，定位误差由19.81降至10.46像素。机器人评测中成功完成3项任务，显示出从人类示范生成可用伪标签的实用价值。
papers.abstract_en: Human videos contain abundant object-manipulation demonstrations, but they do not directly provide motion cues that a robot can follow. We present HOC2R, a Hand-Object Contact trajectory extractor for Robot motion that combines frozen DINOv3 and SAM 2.1 features with learned heads for hand-object association and contact localization. HOC2R supports two modes: count-aware automation that detects, counts, and localizes visible contacts in untrimmed videos, and fixed-two localization for two-finger grippers when contact frames are known. On a 30-task point-annotated benchmark, count-aware automation improves contact-count accuracy from 58.1% to 71.4% and reduces mean localization distance from 19.81 to 10.46 pixels relative to an adapted VRB2 baseline. On seven unseen RGB-D rollouts, a five-task fixed-two checkpoint reduces mean localization distance from 67.67 to 27.02 pixels. Across six robot evaluation sequences, the 30-task fixed-two checkpoint produces four feasible trajectories and succeeds on three tasks, compared with two feasible trajectories and one successful task for each adapted baseline. HOC2R is competitive in the evaluated single-hand scenes, robust to the hand-color shift, and strongest in the evaluated multi-hand scenes. These results support HOC2R as a practical pseudo-labeling method for extracting robot-usable contact trajectories from human demonstrations.

papers.title_en: DobotTrack: Target-Grounded Vision-Language-Action Learning for Embodied Person Tracking
papers.authors: Shengjun Deng, Yinghan Zhang, Chengrui Wei, Liu Liang, Songyuan Liu, Pengkun Zheng, Yajun Zheng, Ying Zhang, Yuan Tian, Xi Li, Teng Wang
papers.evidence: 面向具身目标跟踪的视觉语言动作学习
papers.tldr: 面向语言引导的具身人员跟踪，移动智能体需从指代表述中识别目标，并在第一视角观测变化下持续跟随。DobotTrack提出目标锚定的视觉语言动作框架，引入分割、框定位、视觉空间分类及未来视觉预测等辅助监督，并以Q-identity压缩历史信息。其0.8B模型在EVT-Bench上平均成功率达77.9%，较OmTrackVLA提升16.9个百分点，同时构建了真实四足机器人数据集，推动模拟与现实中的目标感知跟踪学习。
papers.abstract_en: Language-guided embodied person tracking requires a mobile agent to identify a target from a referring description and consistently follow the target under egocentric observations. We present DobotTrack, a target-grounded vision-language-action (VLA) framework that integrates auxiliary grounding supervision with efficient temporal modeling. We systematically investigate five auxiliary tasks---person segmentation, bounding-box grounding, visual-spatial classification (VSC), future DINO feature prediction, and future-frame prediction---and adopt complementary mask and bounding-box supervision to enhance target delineation and localization. We introduce Q-identity, a target-conditioned historical visual compression module that leverages target-grounding predictions to selectively preserve identity-discriminative appearance features and spatial cues in compact historical tokens. On EVT-Bench, our 0.8B-parameter model achieves an average success rate of 77.9%, exceeding OmTrackVLA by 16.9 percentage points across the three tasks. We further construct a real-world person-tracking dataset collected using a quadruped robot, comprising 126 episodes and 596,323 mask-annotated frames. The target masks enable automatic derivation of bounding boxes and visual-spatial labels encoding horizontal position and apparent image scale, providing additional grounding supervision without separate manual annotation of these labels. Together, our framework and annotation pipeline support learning target-grounded tracking policies from simulated and real-world data. Code is available at https://github.com/Dobot-Team/dobot_track.

papers.title_en: Autonomous Whole-body Loco-manipulation Using a Snake Robot
papers.authors: Adarsh Salagame, Henry Noyes, Haroon Hublikar, Alireza Ramezani
papers.evidence: 闭环全身机器人运动与物体操作
papers.tldr: 蛇形机器人可同时依靠全身接触实现运动与操作，但推进、支撑和推物相互耦合，使自主全身运动操作难以规划与控制。论文以COBRA为平台，建立统一的接触隐式动力学模型，并结合几何规划、比例控制与全阶轨迹优化，实现侧向蜿行中自主将物体推至目标位置。硬件实验覆盖多种构型，仿真进一步处理机器人—物体及物体—地面接触，展示了无专用末端执行器进行全身操作的可行性。
papers.abstract_en: Snake robots can leverage their hyper-redundant morphology for both locomotion and manipulation through distributed body contact but whole-body loco-manipulation is particularly challenging since the entire body serves simultaneously as propulsive mechanism and manipulation tool Prior work on wheeled legged and snake robot platforms has decoupled these functions through dedicated appendages body segmentation or grippers We present closed-loop loco-manipulation with our snake robot COBRA without this distinction such that any part of the body may make contact We develop a contact-implicit dynamic model unifying robot-ground robot-object and object-ground interactions within a Moreau-Jean time-stepping framework and formulate a trajectory optimization over the full-order dynamics guided by a geometric planner and nominal proportional controller to autonomously push an object to a goal location during sidewinding We validate the planner and controller on hardware across varied configurations and present simulation results for a simplified trajectory optimization that resolves robot-object and object-ground contacts

papers.title_en: Computer-Use Agents Are Embodied Generalists
papers.authors: Pranjal Aggarwal, Sean Welleck
papers.evidence: 在多种模拟环境中感知并执行任务的通用具身智能体
papers.tldr: 传统具身智能往往依赖针对任务设计的专用方法，泛化能力受到限制。本文将具身任务转化为数字软件交互：用软件呈现物理环境视图，并以截图、键盘和鼠标操作完成行动。采用同一种计算机使用智能体，仅更换环境软件，便在四项ECCV研讨会竞赛中获得第一、第二、第三和第六名。结果表明，智能体在软件中学到的视觉定位、精确点击与探索能力能够迁移至具身任务，支持构建更通用的具身智能模型。
papers.abstract_en: In many areas of AI, general-purpose models have increasingly replaced handcrafted methods and specialized architectures. We argue that embodied AI is poised for a similar shift. Our key claim is that embodied tasks can be formulated as interaction with digital software. Specifically, we build software that renders an agent's view of a physical environment on a screen and provides controls for acting in it. A computer-use agent (CUA) can then perform embodied tasks through the same screenshots and keyboard and mouse actions that it uses to operate ordinary software. Using a single CUA design and changing only the software, our entries win first-, second-, third-, and sixth-place prizes across four ECCV workshop competitions, without any competition-specific agent tuning. These results suggest that the skills CUAs learn on software, such as visual grounding, precise clicking, and exploration, already carry over to embodied tasks, giving CUAs a far broader scope in embodied AI than previously realized. We therefore advocate that computer-use agents can be embodied generalists. Further, we advocate that, by following the training strategy that made computer-use agents general, embodied AI can converge on a single general model as well, ushering in a new era of general embodied AI. Website: https://pranjal2041.github.io/cua-embodied

papers.title_en: OfficeTwin: Realizing 3D Reconstruction of Redundant Scenes through Partial Viewpoint Perception
papers.authors: Quanyun Wu, Kyle Gao, Daisy Li, Kshitij Goyal, Dayou Mao, David A. Clausi, Jonathan Li, Yuhao Chen
papers.evidence: 从机器人有限视角进行前馈三维重建，直接契合DUST3R类重建与场景建模改进
papers.tldr: 面向机器人受限视角下的办公场景三维重建，单目流只能获得不完整、重复且弱纹理的观测，传统匹配与生成式方法易混淆实例并幻觉补全。OfficeTwin先施加度量和结构约束，再将重复工位配准到共享规范坐标系，融合互补观测恢复遮挡几何。真实办公室扫描中，它为每个工位生成独立、具度量尺度且水密的实体，优于前馈重建和生成式基线。该方法把冗余结构转化为重建优势，产出可直接用于机器人仿真的数字孪生资产。
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction turns an uncalibrated monocular stream into a dense point cloud in a single inference pass, orders of magnitude faster than classical structure-from-motion (e.g., COLMAP), and reliable on the weakly textured, repetitive surfaces where keypoint matching fails outright. However, raw point clouds lack the object identity, physical properties, and watertight volume required for robot learning. This gap widens under robot-native capture. A camera mounted on a robot constrained to a few degrees of freedom sees each object only partially, and the repetitive, weakly textured structure of an office makes distinct workstations nearly indistinguishable, leaving redundant and partial observations that downstream reconstruction cannot resolve. Existing image-to-3D generation methods struggle with these conditions, hallucinating geometry under incomplete views and confusing repeated instances. We present OfficeTwin, a robot-native framework that converts these incomplete observations into simulation-ready digital twins. OfficeTwin first imposes metric and structural constraints, then exploits the office's structural redundancy by registering repeated cubicles into a shared canonical frame, where complementary observations recover geometry occluded in any single view without hallucination. On a real office scan, OfficeTwin recovers every cubicle as an individually watertight, metric solid, outperforming feed-forward reconstruction and generative baselines that fail to produce simulation-ready assets.

papers.title_en: CPNav: Calibrated Vision-Language Navigation for Object-Goal Search in Unseen Environments
papers.authors: Qizhao Chen, Yuanhong Zeng, Shoh Nishino, Anushri Dixit
papers.evidence: 未知环境中的视觉语言导航与碰撞感知规划
papers.tldr: 在陌生环境中寻找指定物体是具身智能导航的核心难题，视觉语言模型虽具备语义推理能力，却常产生未经校准且过度自信的动作决策。CPNav结合碰撞感知规划与保序预测校准，对VLM动作分数进行离线风险控制，并通过树状探索与回溯提升决策可靠性。在仿真和真实机器人实验中，成功率与路径效率均显著优于未校准基线，体现了统计校准增强开放环境导航泛化能力的价值。
papers.abstract_en: Directing a robot to locate a target object in unseen environments remains a central challenge in embodied AI. Vision-Language Model (VLM)-based methods provide rich semantic reasoning but often produce uncalibrated and overconfident action decisions. We introduce CPNav, a navigation framework that combines collision-aware planning with statistically calibrated VLM action scoring for map-free object-goal navigation. From RGB-D input, CPNav constructs a navigability map, generates collision-free motion primitives, and queries two VLMs for goal detection and action scoring. The resulting scores are calibrated offline via conformal prediction (CP) using oracle actions obtained through a tree-structured exploration procedure with backtracking, providing finite-sample guarantees at a user-specified risk level. The CP layer is model-agnostic and can wrap any VLM policy. Online, calibrated VLM scores guide action selection, while a tree-structured exploration history records alternative actions and allows backtracking. We evaluate CPNav in both simulation and real-world hardware settings. In AI Habitat simulation, compared with the uncalibrated baseline method, CPNav achieves relative SR and SPL improvements of 6.2% and 11.4% on HM3D v0.2, and 12.4% and 8.8% on MP3D, respectively. In real-world deployment on a modified Hiwonder MentorPi robot, the corresponding improvements in SR and SPL are 24.9% and 15.2%, respectively. Code is available at https://github.com/practice-lab-ucla/CPnav.

papers.title_en: RefineSplat: Reconstruction-Guided Object-Centric Gaussian Splatting for Open-Vocabulary Querying
papers.authors: Yiren Lu, Disheng Liu, Sreya Srinidhi, Yunlai Zhou, Yiran Qiao, Chaoda Song, Tuo Liang, Jing Ma, Huan Wang, Yu Yin
papers.evidence: 面向开放词汇场景理解的对象级三维重建与分割
papers.tldr: 开放词汇三维场景理解需要根据自然语言在复杂静态与动态场景中分割、检索任意物体，但先重建后分割易出现视角不一致、边界模糊和物体对应关系弱。RefineSplat延续先跟踪后重建范式，为每个物体维护专属高斯集合，并以渲染掩码和多视角一致性反向修正二维跟踪。方法还通过按视角聚类分配多语言嵌入，刻画视角相关语义。实验显示其提升渲染视图分割效果、降低物体级倒角距离，并发布含静动态序列及精确几何标注的Blender-OVS基准，兼顾重建质量与可解释的物体级查询。
papers.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding aims to segment and retrieve arbitrary objects in 3D scenes using natural language queries. Most existing methods typically follow a splat-then-segment paradigm, where 3D Gaussian Splatting is first reconstructed and then augmented with labels or language features for subsequent segmentation. However, this pipeline often suffers from view inconsistency, ambiguous object boundaries, and weak object-level correspondence, especially in complex static and dynamic scenes. Building on our prior Segment-then-Splat framework, we present RefineSplat, a reconstruction-guided extension that retains its object-centric paradigm: it first tracks objects in 2D and then reconstructs each object with a dedicated set of 3D Gaussians, preserving explicit object-Gaussian correspondence for unified open-vocabulary segmentation and retrieval. To improve robustness, we further close the loop between 2D tracking and 3D reconstruction. Since off-the-shelf video trackers can produce unreliable masks that propagate errors into object reconstruction, we introduce a reconstruction-guided feedback mechanism that refines object tracking using rendered masks and multi-view consistency. Moreover, instead of assigning each object a single language embedding, we propose a viewpoint-aware embedding assignment strategy, where each object maintains multiple view-clustered embeddings to capture view-dependent semantic cues. We also introduce Blender-OVS, a synthetic benchmark of static and dynamic sequences with exact object meshes and point clouds, enabling direct evaluation of extracted geometry. Experiments on static and dynamic benchmarks show improved rendered-view segmentation and lower object-level Chamfer distances, with competitive scene reconstruction quality.

papers.title_en: Spatial Representation Distillation and Knowledge Routing for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.authors: Jungin Park, Chaoran Zhu, Changjae Oh, Kwanghoon Sohn
papers.evidence: 为视觉语言动作模型学习三维空间表示，增强机器人对物理环境的理解
papers.tldr: 视觉语言动作模型要在真实操作中理解三维物理结构，但现有方法往往依赖推理时显式三维输入，或只使用单一视觉通路，容易损伤预训练视觉语义知识。SPARK-VLA通过空间表征蒸馏与知识路由保留并增强视觉能力，无需外部三维输入或推理专家。它在多个仿真基准及真实操作中取得强劲表现，以0.5B语言骨干和约5300万可训练参数实现高效三维感知，为参数高效的视觉语言动作学习提供了实用方案。
papers.abstract_en: Understanding three-dimensional physical structure has become essential for vision-language-action models (VLAs). However, existing approaches either rely on explicit geometric inputs at inference time or adopt a single visual pathway, potentially compromising the visual-semantic knowledge inherited from pre-trained models. We present SPARK-VLA, Spatial Representation distillation and Knowledge routing for VLAs, a preserve-specialize-route framework for spatially adapting VLAs without requiring external 3D inputs or experts at inference. SPARK-VLA consists of two key components: (1) spatial representation distillation, which transfers 3D understanding from a frozen 3D expert to a LoRA-adapted visual branch by aligning attention responses while preserving the original visual pathway, and (2) a lightweight knowledge router, which selectively forwards action-relevant visual tokens to the language model using routing supervision derived from action-loss gradients. Across LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, CALVIN, and real-world manipulation, SPARK-VLA achieves strong performance with only a 0.5B language backbone and approximately 53M trainable parameters, providing an effective and parameter-efficient approach to 3D-aware VLA learning. Code is available at https://github.com/park-jungin/spark-vla.

papers.title_en: Look Ahead: Search-Driven Reasoning in Embodied AI
papers.authors: Ahmed Zeer, Osama Shbib, Muzaffer Kaan Yuce, Himmet Toprak Kesgin, Mehmet Fatih Amasyali
papers.evidence: 面向具身机器人策略的搜索驱动规划
papers.tldr: 具身智能中的视觉语言动作策略通常需在执行前判断不同未来，但动作分块策略缺少高效的测试时规划。本文在PushT任务中冻结ACT策略，用束搜索围绕其动作块生成扰动候选，并通过克隆模拟器状态回滚评估未来。实验显示成功率由0%升至18%，平均累计奖励由39.44升至103.2；提出的OSA门控机制在保持或提升效果的同时，将运行时间降低约3倍。研究表明，选择性搜索能增强动作分块策略，但更大搜索预算并不必然带来更好表现。
papers.abstract_en: Search allows a robotic policy to evaluate candidate futures before committing to an action. Motivated by test-time planning for vision-language action (VLA) models, we study selective search over action chunks in PushT using a frozen Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT) policy. Beam search generates perturbed alternatives around the policy prediction and scores them through rollouts from cloned simulator states. Across 50 evaluation episodes, beam search raises task success from 0% to 18% and increases average cumulative reward from 39.44 to 103.2. We introduce One Step Ahead (OSA), a gate that simulates the nominal policy chunk and invokes full search only when its predicted coverage drop exceeds a threshold. In the reported ablations, OSA preserves or improves success while reducing runtime by approximately 3x relative to full beam search. Ablations over tree depth, branching factor, beam width, and replanning frequency show that larger search budgets do not consistently improve performance. The results support selective test-time search for action-chunking policies; evaluation on language-conditioned VLAs and physical robots remains future work.

papers.title_en: BAT-WAM: Bridging Action and Touch in World-Action Models for Dexterous Hands
papers.authors: Dong Fang, Feixuan Huang, Yuanxin Zhong, Yuxiang Gao, Qi Song, Yunlong Wang, Xiaosong Jia, Yu-Gang Jiang
papers.evidence: 面向灵巧操作的视觉—关节状态—触觉世界动作模型
papers.tldr: 灵巧手世界动作模型依赖关节状态与全手触觉，但这些模态可能缺失，单靠RGB难以可靠恢复。BAT-WAM通过独立触觉与动作码本、解码器，并以RGB条件连续潜变量桥接双向学习。相较基线，触觉重建RMSE在全遮挡和部分遮挡下分别降低34.73%和38.84%，未来触觉预测降低85.56%。真实机器人及未见物体、场景实验均显示更强性能，证明视觉、手状态与触觉联合建模的价值。
papers.abstract_en: Dexterous manipulation with world action models (WAMs) relies on hand configuration and contact information, yet joint-state and whole-hand tactile observations may be partially or entirely missing. RGB images provide scene context and hand-object geometry but are insufficient to reliably recover these missing modalities. We further observe a correlation between hand state and tactile information. Motivated by this observation, we introduce BAT-WAM, a framework that bridges visual, joint-state, and tactile representations for WAMs. BAT-WAM learns separate codebooks and decoders for the tactile and action streams. An RGB-conditioned continuous latent bridge connects the two streams for bidirectional learning, while visual information serves as continuous context. Under the HTBench evaluation protocol, BAT-WAM reduces the root mean squared error (RMSE) of tactile reconstruction by 34.73% under fully masked conditions and 38.84% under partially masked conditions, relative to an image-conditioned HandTouch checkpoint. For future tactile prediction conditioned on target-time RGB and historical actions, it reduces mean RMSE by 85.56% relative to OpenWAM with HandTouch. Real-robot experiments further show that BAT-WAM consistently outperforms related WAM baselines in dexterous manipulation. Generalization experiments on unseen objects and scenes also demonstrate substantial improvements over baseline models. These findings support joint modeling of visual context, hand state, and touch as a representation approach for multimodal WAMs.

papers.title_en: RoboMoCap: A Large-Scale Whole-Body Motion Capture Dataset with Egocentric Vision for Robot Learning
papers.authors: Mayur Deshmukh, Aaron Tung, Junyi Li, Nikash Bhardwaj, Ademi Adeniji, Vincent Liu, Michael Cho, Jiafei Duan
papers.evidence: 面向人形机器人学习的第一视角视觉与动作捕捉数据集
papers.tldr: 人形机器人要在复杂环境中完成行走、导航与操作，需从人类示范学习兼具视觉与精确下肢信息的全身动作，但第一视角常看不到脚部。RoboMoCap将六个头戴相机、腕部视觉惯性传感与120 Hz光学全身动捕对齐，构建覆盖多样移动与移动操作的大规模数据集。数据含14人、超200小时记录，并支持全身动作重建、足部接触与落点估计、人到人形机器人动作重定向。系统评测表明其为第一视角运动理解和人形机器人学习提供了高保真、可扩展基础。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid robots must coordinate locomotion and manipulation to navigate complex environments and perform everyday tasks. Learning such behaviours from human demonstrations requires accurate whole-body motion paired with egocentric vision, particularly for lower-body movements and foot placements that are frequently invisible from a first-person perspective. However, existing egocentric datasets often lack high-fidelity optical motion capture or systematic coverage of diverse loco-manipulation behaviours. To address this gap, we introduce RoboMoCap, a large-scale multimodal dataset combining egocentric vision with marker-based optical motion capture, specifically designed for locomotion-centric humanoid learning. RoboMoCap comprises over 200 hours of recordings from 14 participants, featuring six head-mounted cameras, wrist-mounted visual and inertial sensing, and optical full-body motion capture at 120 Hz. The dataset systematically covers diverse locomotion primitives, dynamic whole-body movements, and loco-manipulation tasks, including variable-speed walking, turning, constrained navigation, terrain traversal, object transportation, and manipulation during locomotion. It provides temporally aligned multimodal observations and metric whole-body motion representations, enabling the study of human movement beyond directly observable body regions. We systematically evaluate existing methods on three benchmark tasks: egocentric full-body motion reconstruction, foot contact and placement estimation, and human-to-humanoid motion retargeting. By pairing egocentric vision with high-fidelity human motion across diverse locomotion and interaction scenarios, RoboMoCap provides a foundation for egocentric motion understanding and humanoid learning from human demonstrations.

papers.title_en: ObjectWorld: Scaling Object-Centric World Models with A Large-Scale 3D Full-Object Flow Dataset
papers.authors: Haonan Chen, Sicheng Isabella Lu, Haitian Li, Jiajin Wu, Hexiang Wei, Jiawei Zhang, Xin Fei, Yiwen Hou, Chenrui Tie, Chongkai Gao, Sheng Wang, Lin Shao
papers.evidence: 用于预测物体运动的对象中心三维世界模型表示
papers.tldr: 面向机器人操作的视觉世界模型缺乏可大规模监督、且能覆盖遮挡区域的对象运动表示。论文提出三维全对象流，为目标物体完整表面点赋予稠密三维轨迹，统一描述刚体与可变形物体。作者构建包含1210小时真实视频与物理仿真的数据集，并训练根据图像和任务描述预测对象流的世界模型。实验显示标注质量可靠、预测性能随数据扩展提升，并能迁移到新场景和不同机器人上，支持可执行的下游操作。
papers.abstract_en: Generative world modeling from large-scale visual data offers a promising path toward scalable robot manipulation. This calls for an intermediate representation that can be supervised at scale and remains actionable for downstream control. We propose 3D full-object flow, an object-centric motion representation that assigns dense 3D trajectories to points across the complete surface of a target object, including its occluded regions. By extending visible-surface object flow to the full object geometry, this representation makes complete object motion explicit and applies uniformly to both rigid and deformable objects. To realize the potential of this representation at scale, we introduce a 1210-hour full-object flow dataset that addresses the scarcity of large-scale supervision for complete 3D object motion. The dataset integrates diverse real-world videos and physical simulations, with a scalable annotation pipeline for recovering full-object motion from real-world observations and quality metrics for systematically assessing annotation quality. We then train a world model that takes an image and a task description as input and predicts dense full-object flow over the reconstructed object geometry. Experiments show reliable annotation quality, data-scalable flow prediction, and effective downstream manipulation across novel scenes and robot embodiments. Project website with additional results and videos: https://nus-lins-lab.github.io/ObjectWorld/.

papers.title_en: Control-Aware Command Generation for Asynchronous Control and Action Inference with Vision-Based Policies towards Fast Execution
papers.authors: Takayuki Osa, Kazuki Ota
papers.evidence: 面向真实机器人的视觉感知与动作执行控制
papers.tldr: 视觉控制策略包括视觉语言动作模型，但高成本动作推理常成为机器人执行速度瓶颈。本文不改动底层策略学习，提出异步推理与控制框架，将离散预测转化为连续目标位置跟踪，并依据位置预测方差自适应跳过动作。在双臂机器人上的动作分块变换器和OpenVLA-OFT实验中，执行速度显著提升且任务成功率保持较高水平。研究表明，从控制层设计可兼顾快速执行、平滑运动与稳定性，为视觉策略部署提供实用路径。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-based control policies, including vision-language-action models, have enabled robots to perform increasingly complex tasks. However, their execution speed is often limited by the high computational cost of action inference. In this work, we investigate what can be achieved at the control level without modifying the underlying policy learning process. We introduce an asynchronous inference and control framework that enables fast task execution while maintaining smooth and stable robot motions. By formulating the generation of continuous target positions from discontinuous model predictions as a tracking control problem, our method makes asynchronous inference practical for real robots. We further accelerate execution through adaptive action skipping based on the variance of predicted positions. Experiments with Action Chunking Transformer and OpenVLA-OFT on a bimanual robot demonstrate substantial speedups while preserving high task success rates.

papers.title_en: HARP-Bench: Benchmarking Robot Manipulation Around Active Humans
papers.authors: Qinhong Zhou, Riley Zong, Chunru Lin, Diyi Hu, Shivraj Singh Bhatti, Hongxin Zhang, Lin Qiu, Hanqing Zeng, Chuang Gan
papers.evidence: 评估人与机器人共同工作空间中的机器人操作
papers.tldr: 现有机器人操作基准多将机器人视为工作空间中的唯一行动者，难以评估人类主动参与带来的目标提示、任务协作与安全约束。HARP-Bench将人类活动纳入操作问题，设置提示、贡献、中断和共存四类条件，并提供动态场景示范数据。评测显示，人类在场会显著挑战现有策略，成功率提升也未必伴随安全性改善，操作与恢复是主要短板。基准训练可提升仿真及部分真实任务表现，为研究面向真实共享空间的机器人操作提供了系统工具。
papers.abstract_en: Recent robot manipulation benchmarks have enabled systematic evaluation of general-purpose robot policies across diverse objects, scenes, instructions, and embodiments. However, most existing benchmarks still assume that the robot is the only active agent and that task semantics are determined primarily by the instruction and object state. This assumption overlooks a common source of real-world variation: humans actively sharing the workspace. In such settings, humans may reveal an implicit goal, complete part of the task, temporarily change object availability, or constrain safe robot motion while working nearby. We introduce HARP-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating robot manipulation policies in workspaces shared with active humans. HARP-Bench treats human activity as part of the manipulation problem, rather than as background scene variation. It organizes human-present manipulation into four conditions: Cueing, Contribution, Interruption, and Co-presence. These conditions are instantiated through everyday manipulation tasks, including paired human-present variants for controlled comparison with standard manipulation. HARP-Bench also provides a demonstration-generation pipeline for dynamic human-present settings. We evaluate VLA models, imitation-learning methods, and heuristic policies on HARP-Bench. Human-present variations challenge current policies, and higher task success does not consistently improve safety. Quantitative failure analysis identifies manipulation and recovery as the dominant remaining challenges. Training with HARP-Bench demonstrations improves human-present performance in simulation. A real-world study on one task family shows improved performance under human contribution, but not interruption, providing initial evidence of the data's utility and identifying limits of transfer. Code is available at https://github.com/UMass-Embodied-AGI/harp.

papers.title_en: DexForesight: Grounding Dexterous Policies with Implicit Spatial Foresight
papers.authors: Zhongxi Chen, Yi Yang, Xinyi Chen, Mingzhe Ye, Yaping Li, Zhihong Liu, Congsheng Xu, Haonan Wang, Zhijie Deng
papers.evidence: 面向灵巧操作的动作条件空间世界模型
papers.tldr: 灵巧操作需要同时理解环境变化与机械手内部、尤其是被遮挡手指的空间动态，但现有世界—动作模型多依赖显式未来预测，部署成本较高。DexForesight从离线深度、手部运动学几何和示范轨迹中学习动作条件空间世界模型，将三维手部点运动与视觉特征变化注入策略潜空间。部署时仅使用RGB、语言和机器人状态，在11项DexJoCo任务上将成功率由49.4%提升至60.5%，真实机器人三项任务达58.3%。该方法以隐式空间预见增强灵巧策略，兼顾遮挡动态建模与实际部署简洁性。
papers.abstract_en: Dexterous manipulation requires rich spatial foresight over both the surrounding scene and the robot hand. Existing world-action models often acquire such predictive knowledge through explicit future prediction. We introduce DexForesight, a framework that learns spatial foresight implicitly by injecting dynamics-aware world representations into the latent space of a dexterous policy. During training, DexForesight learns an action-conditioned spatial world model from offline scene depth, kinematic hand geometry, and demonstration trajectories. The world model predicts 3D hand-point motion and visual feature changes, capturing both articulated hand dynamics and scene changes under demonstrated actions, including the motion of fingers occluded from the cameras. We then freeze the world model and align policy queries with its predictive world queries, transferring the learned spatial dynamics into policy latents and using them to condition action generation. At deployment, only the policy is retained, operating on RGB observations, language, and robot state without depth input or explicit future prediction. On 11 DexJoCo simulation tasks, DexForesight improves the overall success rate of the base policy from 49.4% to 60.5%. On three real-robot dexterous manipulation tasks, DexForesight achieves 58.3% success, compared with 50.0% for the strongest baseline.Project page https://dexforesight.github.io/

papers.title_en: Martine: Benchmarking Multi-View 3D Surface Reconstruction Across Viewpoint Coverage, Resolution, and Lighting
papers.authors: Robin Bruneau, Baptiste Brument, Frederic Giraud, Bastian Sigrist, Sascha Jecklin, Philipp Fürnstahl, Bjoern Menze, Lilian Calvet
papers.evidence: 多视角三维表面重建基准评测
papers.tldr: 多视角三维表面重建的精度同时受算法、物体材质与采集条件影响，现有基准在视点覆盖、分辨率、光照和真实几何方面存在局限。Martine构建了受控采集基准，覆盖28个物体、透明材质与精细结构，并提供高分辨率多光照数据、精确扫描真值及误差分析掩码。实验比较了摄影测量、传统多视图立体、神经隐式表面、基于高斯溅射的重建和多视图光度立体方法，最佳可见表面倒角距离达0.058毫米。该基准支持按采集条件和物体属性进行细粒度、公平且可复现的重建评测。
papers.abstract_en: Controlled acquisition setups are widely used for high-accuracy multi-view 3D surface reconstruction, as they allow sensor configuration, image resolution, viewpoint distribution, and illumination to be specified. Yet benchmarking remains difficult, since reconstruction accuracy depends jointly on the reconstruction paradigm, object properties, and acquisition regime. Existing benchmarks often restrict viewpoint coverage, resolution, or illumination, which can bias comparisons towards methods suited to the chosen setting. Others lack accurate 3D ground truth or quantified image-to-geometry alignment, limiting their use for metric surface evaluation. We introduce Martine, a benchmark for controlled 3D object surface reconstruction. Martine comprises 28 objects, including transparent materials and fine structures, captured at 9568 x 6376 pixels from 84 views over a spherical cap under both single-light and multi-light regimes. It provides object-independent camera calibration, accurate 3D ground-truth scans, calibration and image-to-geometry accuracy quantified on test images, and 3D property masks for analysing errors by material properties, visibility, curvature and fine structures. Experiments across photogrammetry, classical multi-view stereo, neural implicit surfaces, Gaussian-splatting-based reconstruction, and multi-view photometric stereo show that Martine enables regime-aware evaluation with explicit control over reference-data accuracy. The benchmark resolves sub-millimetric reconstruction differences, with a best observed Chamfer distance of 0.058 mm over the evaluated visible surface.

papers.title_en: PA-SaR: Perception-Aware Learning, Control, and Coordination for Multi-Robot Search and Rescue
papers.authors: Jocubas Dimsa, Maria Grouev, Filip Keerberg, Nicolas Laplagne, Tigo Schutgens, Sven Schoonebeek, Anahita Jamshidnejad
papers.evidence: 面向多机器人搜救的感知驱动探索与协同控制
papers.tldr: 自主搜索救援要求机器人在未知环境中兼顾探索、避险、协同与受害者引导，但局部能力提升未必转化为任务收益。论文提出PA-SaR，将异构控制、学习探索、监督式任务分配和自适应引导置于统一任务框架。仿真表明，安全避碰与搜索完成存在权衡，监督分配优于单纯信息共享，探索增强也不必然带来更多救援。自适应引导相较持续领航提升救援数，却未显著改善信任或降低死亡率，为分解评估搜索救援系统提供依据。
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous SaR requires robots to explore unknown or partially known environments, avoid hazards, coordinate team activities, and guide discovered victims to safety. Improving individual capabilities of robots does not necessarily improve mission outcomes: safer motion can restrict the exploration behavior, faster discovery can increase the rescue demand, and effective guidance depends on victim responses. We introduce PA-SaR, a mathematical and architectural framework for coordinating heterogeneous local control, learning-based exploration, supervisory task allocation, and adaptive approach-lead victim guidance around mission-level objectives. PA- SaR distinguishes environmental ground-truth, robot-specific perceptions, and simulated victim behavior. This provides a common basis for integrating complementary mechanisms and analyzing their interactions across mission stages. We demonstrate the framework through single- and multi-robot simulation studies incorporating model-predictive and learning-based exploration, perception-based safety shielding, event-driven task allocation, and adaptive victim guidance. The results show trade-offs between collision avoidance and search completion, indicate that supervisory allocation improves search completion beyond information sharing alone, and demonstrate that increased exploration does not necessarily yield more rescues. Adaptive guidance increases rescues relative to continuous leading, without a detected improvement in mean or final victim trust or a reduction in mortality. These findings support evaluating local control, team coordination, and evacuation as related but distinct aspects of autonomous SaR within the considered simulation environments.

papers.title_en: HINT-VLM: Humanoid Interactive Navigation over Rough Terrain with Embodiment-Grounded Vision-Language Model
papers.authors: Ziwon Yoon, Seok Hwan Kim, Yiyu Chen, Quan Nguyen, Lu Gan, Ye Zhao
papers.evidence: 结合地形感知与可移动物体交互的人形机器人导航
papers.tldr: 面向崎岖户外地形中的人形机器人可交互导航，传统方法难以同时处理地形可通行性与障碍物可移动性。论文提出结合视觉语言模型语义先验与机器人交互数据的混合规划框架，并用高斯过程修正可移动性估计。经概率建模后，系统开展分层不确定性感知规划，使机器人协同利用行走与操作能力安全、高效通行。该工作实现了崎岖地形下基于预测式可移动性推理的NAMO方案。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid robots have achieved significant progress in locomotion and manipulation, enabling traversal over rough terrain and richer interaction with the environment, such as moving obstacles. However, most traditional navigation methods assume non-interactive environments and focus only on traversal. While Navigation Among Movable Obstacles (NAMO) approaches relax this assumption, prior efforts have largely focused on flat environments and reactive interaction, rather than predicting object movability and planning ahead. These limitations become critical in outdoor rough-terrain scenarios, where robots must jointly reason about terrain traversability and object movability. In this work, we address NAMO for humanoid robots in cluttered outdoor rough terrain by proposing a hybrid planning framework that combines semantic priors from a Vision-Language Model (VLM) with embodied robot interaction data through a Gaussian process (GP) residual model. The GP corrects the VLM-derived movability prior to produce embodiment-grounded probabilistic movability estimates, which are then incorporated into hierarchical uncertainty-aware planning. The proposed approach allows humanoids to jointly leverage locomotion and manipulation for efficient and safe navigation, representing the first solution to NAMO in rough terrain through predictive movability reasoning and probabilistic VLM integration.

papers.title_en: GeoPilot: Diagnosis-Guided Interventions and Geometric Evaluation for Aerial Reconstruction
papers.authors: Pengyu Yin, Jie Pan, Junxiang Tan, Mengqi Fu, Kun Cheng, Yifan Liu
papers.evidence: 面向航空影像网格重建的诊断、参数干预与定量评估
papers.tldr: 航拍遥感影像重建的网格若与参考几何不一致，关键在于定位误差来源并选择可执行的修改。GeoPilot将诊断、先验观察转化为程序或相机配置干预，由大模型提出方案、数值工具重建、外部评估器按坐标与参考协议测量。实验显示共享内参在原生坐标下提升六项指标并使平均距离下降7.04%，发布的固定相机在匹配去畸变图像上下降12.11%。研究同时揭示评估坐标系会改变结论，为条件化相机处理和几何评估提供工作流。
papers.abstract_en: When a mesh reconstructed from aerial remote-sensing imagery disagrees with reference geometry, deciding what to change requires a diagnosis of the reconstruction process. We present GeoPilot, a workflow that turns diagnostics and prior observations into executable program or camera-configuration interventions. A large language model proposes the change, numerical tools reconstruct the mesh, and an external evaluator measures its geometry under a stated coordinate and reference protocol. The main case tests a shared-intrinsics hypothesis proposed before the comparison. On 224 Metashape-raster development images, shared intrinsics improved all six native-coordinate measures and reduced mean surface-to-reference distance by 7.04%. Reference-assisted alignment fitted and evaluated on separate within-scene checkerboard samples reversed the mean-distance ranking, limiting that gain to native-frame delivery. A separate matched comparison on publisher-undistorted images favored fixed published cameras on all six measures, reducing mean distance by 12.11%; the cameras retain upstream image and laser-scanning adjustment information. With one reconstruction per configuration, these comparisons provide conditional evidence for camera handling. Three end-to-end runs each delivered a mesh and six-metric evaluation from all 327 images of a second development scene.

papers.title_en: Action Representation for Spatial Generalization in Robot World Models
papers.authors: Yuhang Sun
papers.evidence: 用于机器人世界模型结果预测的动作表示研究
papers.tldr: 机器人世界模型要在空间配置变化下复用物理知识，关键在于动作表示是否保留决定后果的关系。论文在受控机器人剥皮任务中，对比世界坐标、物体坐标和表面坐标下的匹配动作表示，并测试全局位姿、接触位置、剥离厚度及执行偏差的影响。结果表明，表面相对坐标能提升后果预测和反事实动作选择，但依赖准确的局部观测；缺失厚度信息会造成不可消除的预测歧义。研究据此提出，空间泛化不应只追求坐标变化最小化，而应保留动作、状态与物理后果之间的关键关系。
papers.abstract_en: Spatial generalization in robot world models depends on whether action representations capture the physical relationships that remain valid across changing spatial configurations. Yet different coordinates can describe the same interaction, whereas similar motions can produce different outcomes when local physical conditions change. How these distinctions affect learned prediction remains insufficiently understood. This study evaluates matched action representations defined in world, object, and surface coordinate frames using a controlled robotic peeling benchmark. Global pose and contact relocation experiments reveal a cost associated with limited training data when equivalent interactions receive different spatial descriptions. Removing information about peel thickness creates an irreducible ambiguity because identical predictive inputs can correspond to different material removal outcomes. Coordinates defined relative to the surface improve consequence prediction and counterfactual action selection under accurate local observations, but learned predictors remain vulnerable to uncertainty in the coordinate frame. Joint centering of the surface and tool removes sensitivity to translation of their common origin, whereas incorrect contact geometry and actual execution deviations introduce different failure mechanisms. These results show that effective spatial generalization depends on preserving the relationships between actions and states that determine physical consequences, rather than simply minimizing coordinate variation. This perspective provides a principled basis for designing robot world models that reuse physical knowledge across spatial configurations while retaining the distinctions essential to prediction and planning.

papers.title_en: CSG-Nav: Confidence-Aware Semantic-Geometric Fusion for Robust Exploration and Accurate Zero-Shot Object-Goal Navigation
papers.authors: Shoubin Chen, Rui Xu, Zehao Wu, Kai Zhang, Tao Huang, Zhou Liu, Qingquan Li
papers.evidence: 面向零样本目标导航的语义几何融合
papers.tldr: 零样本物体目标导航需要在陌生环境中探索并定位目标，却容易受远距离感知不可靠、视觉语言模型幻觉和语义误停影响。CSG-Nav提出置信度感知的语义—几何融合框架，从语义来源、空间距离和终止决策三个层面抑制方向偏置并提升定位可靠性。在HM3D v1、HM3D v2和MP3D上，成功率分别达到58.9%、71.6%和44.3%，并通过消融与真实部署验证有效性。该方法将开放词汇语义判断与深度三维定位结合，为不确定感知下的稳健探索和物理可信目标停止提供了通用方案。
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot object-goal navigation requires autonomous agents to explore unseen environments and locate target objects without task-specific training, posing challenges in perceptual reliability under observation uncertainty and physically grounded goal termination. Although foundation-model-based approaches improve generalization, they remain vulnerable to unreliable long-range perception, hallucination-induced directional bias, and semantically plausible but geometrically incorrect stopping decisions. To address these limitations, we propose CSG-Nav, a zero-shot navigation framework centered on confidence-aware multimodal information fusion. CSG-Nav integrates three complementary fusion mechanisms. First, semantic-source fusion integrates open-vocabulary detection results, detection confidence, scene observations, and relational reasoning to produce more reliable direction-level semantic scores and suppress hallucination-induced directional bias. Second, spatial-confidence fusion weights multi-view semantic evidence using a Gaussian decay function, suppressing unreliable distant observations while accumulating spatially consistent exploration preferences. Third, semantic-geometric decision fusion combines semantic target detection with depth-based 3D localization to support physically grounded stopping decisions. Experiments on HM3Dv1, HM3Dv2, and MP3D demonstrate competitive zero-shot performance, achieving success rates of 58.9%, 71.6%, and 44.3%. Fusion-level ablations and real-world deployments in indoor and outdoor environments further verify the effectiveness and practicality of CSG-Nav for robust navigation under uncertain perception. Code is available at https://xr-ui.github.io/CSGNav.github.io/

papers.title_en: Learning Contextual Motion Constraints for Object Rearrangement Exploration
papers.authors: Lexing Zhang, Zeyu Zhang, Gang Zeng, Hangxin Liu
papers.evidence: 机器人感知预测关节运动与障碍约束以完成物体重排
papers.tldr: 在杂乱环境中，关节部件的可运动范围同时受自身关节限制与外部障碍物影响，现有方法往往忽略后者。论文提出双流网络 MoCo-Net，利用部分视角点云联合预测连续运动范围和潜在碰撞区域热图。实验表明，两类预测相互促进，可提升新物体、新场景上的约束与障碍识别精度，并构建紧凑场景构型空间。该空间支持定制规划器高效探索重排动作，为面向上下文约束的机器人物体重排提供了有效方案。
papers.abstract_en: The motion of an articulated part in cluttered surroundings is constrained not only by an object's intrinsic joint limits but also by extrinsic obstacles. However, existing approaches primarily consider object articulation properties alone. Here we present Motion Constraint Prediction Network (MoCo-Net), a two-stream neural network that jointly predicts the continuous motion ranges of articulated parts and obstacle heatmaps highlighting potential collision regions from partial-view point cloud observation. By capturing both internal and external motion constraints, MoCo-Net produces more accurate feasible motion range prediction and obstacles recognition, improves generalization for novel objects in new scenes, and enables robots to construct a scene configuration space for efficient exploration of rearrangement actions. Our experiments show that MoCo-Net's two-stream design enhances each other to deliver more accurate predictions, which subsequently form a compact configuration space for a customized planner to efficiently rearrange the scene.

papers.title_en: Compass 1: Towards Open-World and Persistent Embodied Navigation from Monocular RGB Videos
papers.authors: Hai Zhang, Siqi Liang, Yanjun Guo, Shoufeng Zhang, Yunhao Wang, Hangyu Du, Haoguang Mai, Hongchen Li, Jiazhi Yang, Jialong Zeng, Yu Hu, Chen Chen, Gangcheng Jiang, Zishun Zhuo, Lirui Zhao, Zhigang Li, Yu Qiao, Zhenjie Yang, Fu Zhang, Hongyang Li
papers.evidence: 具备长期视觉记忆的具身导航
papers.tldr: 开放世界具身导航需要长期空间记忆与稳定的长时程执行，但现有架构通常只能利用最近几帧信息。Compass 1在不改动底层架构的情况下，引入历史表示与历史利用机制，将稀疏关键帧、历史表示地图和结构化视觉问答监督结合起来，支持近两分钟视觉历史回溯。模型在多种机器人形态和场景中取得79.4%的总体成功率，显著提升探索与持续历史回溯能力，并借助大规模真实交互和网络视频数据推动开放世界导航研究。
papers.abstract_en: Embodied navigation requires agents to achieve persistent spatial awareness and long-horizon execution stability in open-world environments. However, existing navigation architectures struggle to sustain both capabilities, remaining effective only over a handful of recent frames. We present Compass 1, the first embodied navigation foundation model to unify language understanding and video generation while enabling memory backtracking through nearly 2mins of visual history. Without altering the underlying architecture, we introduce History Representation, which integrates sparse visual keyframes with an explicit History Representation Map to preserve long-term spatiotemporal context. To effectively leverage this history, we further introduce History Utilization, a structured VQA supervision protocol comprising three categories: task-stage grounding, exploration consistency, and spatiotemporal target retrieval, enabling map-grounded reasoning and stable persistent long-horizon navigation. To fuel this system, we establish a complete annotation pipeline for monocular RGB videos and open-source a massive dataset featuring over 500 hours of high-quality real-world interactions and over 2,000 hours of annotated web videos. Trained mainly on the distribution of 1m height camera, Compass 1 generalizes seamlessly across diverse embodiments and scenarios, ranging from indoor environments to pedestrian-dense streets, spanning wheeled robot at 0.35m, quadruped dog at 0.5m, humanoid at 0.85m, and aerial drone at 1.5m. Compass 1achieves a dominant overall success rate of 79.4% across open-world evaluations, compared to 17.8% for the strongest baseline. It demonstrates exceptional zero-shot execution exceeding 90% on foundational tasks, a 250% boost in exploration, and an unparalleled leap from 0% to 58% in challenging persistent history backtracking.

papers.title_en: Embodied First Exam
papers.authors: Kangrui Wang, Qineng Wang, Changhe Chen, Pingyue Zhang, Chi Gui, Feishi Wang, Canyu Chen, Wenli Xiao, Xiaoyu Huang, Tonghe Zhang, Linjie Li, Zihan Wang, Minyeong Kim, Yiyou Sun, Mingkai Deng, Jinyu Hou, Qi Zhu, Han Liu, Eric P. Xing, Huaxiu Yao, Zhiwen Fan, Yuejiang Liu, Dawn Song, Pieter Abbeel, Li Fei-Fei, Jiajun Wu, Yuke Zhu, Guanya Shi, Ruohan Zhang, Manling Li
papers.evidence: 面向多类实体机器人的智能体控制综合评测基准
papers.tldr: 随着编码智能体开始参与机器人控制，传统聚焦视觉运动策略学习的基准难以评估其在物理约束下驾驭多样机器人的能力。论文提出统一且面向智能体的 Embodied First Exam，允许智能体自主选择直接控制、编程控制或训练策略，并覆盖47台机器人、35个套件的1,156项任务。核心任务中，最强系统GPT-6 Astra在Codex中于标准设置成功率仅34%，显示可靠性仍有较大提升空间。该基准还通过多种环境权限与失败阶段标注，系统揭示编码智能体进入真实物理世界前的能力边界。
papers.abstract_en: Early successes on agentic robotics point to a potential paradigm shift toward using coding agents to control robots. Existing robotics benchmarks are built around visuomotor policy learning, leaving it open whether coding agents can reliably control diverse robots under physical-world constraints. We therefore introduce the Embodied First Exam, a unified, comprehensive, and agent-native evaluation framework where coding agents can choose their own control approach: direct control, code to control, or train a policy to control. We hope it serves as a first exam for coding agents before they enter the physical world, with 1,156 tasks in 35 suites on 47 robots, including 9 new suites that go beyond pick-and-place to spatial puzzles, dexterous manipulation, multi-robot interaction, dynamic whole-body control, and sim-to-sim engineering. Each task can be run in up to three evaluation settings. The Standard Setting mimics the real world: the agent receives only sensor observations and, by default, cannot reset the environment. Its Realtime variant keeps the environment running while the agent reasons. The Privileged Setting gives the agent access to the full simulator state and unlimited resets, allowing it to search for an oracle solution for training purposes. Success rates in this setting serve as an approximate upper bound. On the 456 core tasks, the strongest of eight agents, GPT-6 Astra in Codex, achieves a success rate of 34% in the Standard Setting, leaving much room for improvement. To see where agents fail, we label the stage at which failed attempts go wrong and compare failures across agents, settings, and stage categories.

papers.title_en: Be My Eye: Learning to See Beyond a Robot's Own Perspective
papers.authors: Baifu Huang, Shilin Fang, Jianan Wang
papers.evidence: 具身多机器人共享任务相关感知以协同决策与行动
papers.tldr: 真实环境中的机器人受限于自身视角，单个机器人常无法获得完成任务所需的完整信息，通信受限时尤为明显。本文提出面向任务的主动上下文共享框架，不直接传输原始观测，而是结合任务指令、未来预测与软任务进度对应学习，压缩出紧凑且有用的上下文表示。该表示进一步接入预训练VLA策略，并通过双向信息交换辅助动作生成，在受限通信预算下显著提升协作性能。受控实验与三项真实双机器人任务验证了方法有效性，体现了从被动视觉传输到主动任务导向共享的转变。
papers.abstract_en: Robots operating in the real world are inherently subject to partial observability, particularly in multi-robot collaboration, where individual observations may be insufficient for effective task execution. A key challenge is leveraging complementary observations from partner robots to support collaborative decision-making. We argue that information sharing should go beyond passively transmitting raw observations or generic visual features. Instead, robots should selectively encode task-relevant information according to task objectives and execution progress. To this end, we propose a task-oriented active context sharing framework that transforms robot observations into compact representations, preserving critical information under constrained communication budgets. The framework adopts a two-stage training paradigm. In the first stage, onboard observations and task instructions are jointly encoded into compact context representations. Task-oriented future prediction and soft task-progress correspondence learning guide this collaboration-agnostic compression, preserving information about task objectives and execution progress. In the second stage, the learned representations are integrated into a pretrained Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policy, enabling bidirectional context exchange. Each robot combines complementary partner information with local observations to guide action generation. Action supervision jointly refines the context representations and policy, aligning information sharing with collaborative decision-making. Controlled experiments demonstrate substantial performance gains under constrained communication budgets, while three real-world experiments validate the framework in complex dual-robot tasks. These results highlight a shift from passive visual transmission toward active, task-oriented context sharing that directly supports collaborative decision-making.

papers.title_en: Bridging Task Planning and Execution for Language-Conditioned Bimanual Manipulation
papers.authors: Emanuele Cuzzocrea, Giuseppina Iannotti, Luca Rossini, Arturo Laurenzi, Nikos Tsagarakis
papers.evidence: 结合语义场景关系与执行约束的双臂机器人操作
papers.tldr: 面向家庭辅助和物流等杂乱环境，双臂人形机器人执行语言指令时，任务规划必须同时考虑目标语义、障碍处理、双臂协调与物理可行性。论文提出零样本视觉语言框架，将语义关系和执行约束统一到结构化场景表示中，并以带前后置条件的并行双臂阶段组织动作。分层验证器结合感知不确定性和执行历史，支持局部恢复与定向重规划。在CENTAURO机器人九个语言操控场景中，该方法取得更高成功率，并以更少模型查询恢复执行失败，体现了规划与执行协同的价值。
papers.abstract_en: Robots are increasingly expected to execute natural-language manipulation tasks in real-world environments. This is particularly relevant in household assistance and logistics, where clutter requires reasoning about both task objectives and execution feasibility. This challenge becomes even more pronounced for bimanual humanoid platforms, where coordinating two manipulators introduces additional interaction and kinematic constraints. We present a zero-shot vision-language framework for execution-aware bimanual manipulation that jointly reasons about task objectives and physical feasibility. Planning is grounded in a structured scene representation that combines semantic object relations with execution constraints, enabling the selection of obstacle relocations and execution choices while preserving task semantics. Compatible actions are organised into parallel bimanual stages with explicit pre- and post-conditions. A hierarchical validator evaluates these conditions under perceptual uncertainty and uses stage-level execution history to support local recovery or targeted replanning. Experiments on the CENTAURO hybrid wheeled-legged humanoid robot across nine language-conditioned manipulation scenarios show higher task success than a non-execution-aware baseline. In dedicated failure scenarios, hierarchical validation recovers from execution failures with fewer model queries than always replanning. These results demonstrate the benefits of combining execution reasoning directly into task planning. Videos and additional material are available on the Project Webpage: https://advrhumanoids.github.io/bridging-planning-execution/.

papers.title_en: V3DSAM: Semantic-Geometric Loop Verification and Geometry-Anchored Persistent Instance Mapping for Feed-Forward Dense SLAM
papers.authors: Maolin Ye, Dongqing Zhao, Linyang Li, Shuai Xue, Yuan Liu, Yiyuan Wang, Wen Li
papers.evidence: 针对VGGT-SLAM的前馈几何建图与语义回环改进
papers.tldr: 面向长序列前馈式稠密SLAM中跨视角关联不可靠的问题，V3DSAM融合VGGT-SLAM 2.0的几何估计与SAM3的开放词汇语义观测。方法以像素双向重投影和物体级三维空间对应进行双尺度回环验证，并以全局优化坐标中的几何锚定持久实例映射分配全局ID。TUM RGB-D中成功拒绝全部4个错误回环，ScanNet长序列中提升实例身份一致性。系统无需依赖骨干内部特征或跨帧身份传播，为长期稳健关联提供了更具物理依据的方案。
papers.abstract_en: To address unreliable cross-view association in long-sequence feed-forward dense SLAM, this letter presents V3DSAM, an open-vocabulary semantic dense SLAM system that establishes physical correspondences at both the scene and object levels. The system combines feed-forward geometric estimates from VGGT-SLAM 2.0 with open-vocabulary semantic observations from SAM3. We introduce semantic-geometric dual-scale loop verification, which identifies false loop closures using pixel-level bidirectional reprojection and object-level 3D spatial correspondences, without accessing backbone-internal features. We further propose geometry-anchored persistent instance mapping, which defines physical instances through class-constrained 3D connectivity in an optimized global coordinate system and assigns global IDs without inter-frame identity propagation. The proposed verifier rejects all four false loop candidates in our TUM RGB-D evaluation, while long-sequence ScanNet experiments show improved instance identity consistency. Thus, V3DSAM reduces dependence on internal backbone features and temporal ID propagation for robust long-term cross-view association.

papers.title_en: $Σ$-LeWM: Learning World Models via S-Information for Robot Control
papers.authors: Xinrui Zu, Michael Przystupa, Zhao Yang, Shujian Yu, Kevin Sebastian Luck
papers.evidence: 用于预测机器人环境动力学与动作后果的潜在世界模型
papers.tldr: 机器人控制中的世界模型需要学习既稳定又可预测的潜在表示，但无解码器方法仍可能缺乏足够结构，影响规划效率。本文在LeWorldModel基础上引入反向动力学预测器与逆动力学动作预测器，并结合S-Information增强潜在空间约束。在标准世界模型基准和两个模拟机器人操作任务上，方法取得更好的控制性能与规划效率。研究表明，结构化潜在表示有助于推动世界模型用于实时机器人控制。
papers.abstract_en: World models have increasingly been applied as a model-based control method for robotics tasks such as manipulation and locomotion. While early world model architectures relied on decoders to prevent mode collapse and learn a predictable latent space, recent works on world models, such as Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture or LeWorldModel, increasingly aim to learn embeddings without a grounding decoder, utilising only a latent forward dynamics predictor and a stabilising entropy term. In this paper, we set out to demonstrate that the further introduction of two additional latent losses to LeWorldModel, a backward dynamics predictor and an inverse dynamics action predictor, enforces further structure on the latent embedding, leading to further gains in both performance and planning efficiency. These are critical properties for improving the applicability of such methods to real-time model-based control of real-world robots. We demonstrate these gains on standard world model benchmarks and two simulated robot manipulation tasks.

papers.title_en: Learning Heterogeneous Tactile Representation for General Dexterous Manipulation
papers.authors: Bing Han, Yichuan Peng, Haoyu Dong, Yuanmeng Hu, Yongyi Jia, Fangjing Wang, Kecheng Zheng, Yiming Zhang, Yanhong Zeng, Xiaoqing Zhang, Chen Song, Rundong Zou, Anqi Dong, Yuan Guan, Ka Leong Cheng, Xing Zhu, Yujun Shen, Nan Xue, Wei Ning
papers.evidence: 面向灵巧机器人操作的跨传感器触觉表示
papers.tldr: 触觉是灵巧操作中处理接触信息的关键模态，但压阻、磁性和视觉触觉传感器各有优势与局限，导致模型难以跨硬件泛化。论文提出触觉基础模型LingBot-Touch，学习不同传感器间统一且可扩展的表示，并输出可插拔触觉标记。该表示可接入扩散策略及π0.5、LingBot-VLA等视觉语言动作模型，在仿真和多平台真实机器人实验中持续提升复杂操作能力，同时保持较高计算效率。研究表明，跨传感器触觉学习有望扩大触觉数据规模，并推动硬件与具身模型协同设计。
papers.abstract_en: Tactile sensing is an indispensable modality for contact-rich dexterous manipulation, a capability that hints at the ultimate frontiers of embodied intelligence. However, commercially available tactile sensors are still at a relatively early stage of development, with each type of sensor offering irreplaceable strengths alongside its own drawbacks. A key challenge is thus to free tactile understanding from sensor-specific physics, so that embodied models can effectively leverage heterogeneous tactile data. To this end, we develop LingBot-Touch, a tactile foundation model characterized by the following properties. (i) Our model yields a unified representation across different tactile sensors (i.e., piezoresistive, magnetic, and visuotactile sensors), and is easily extensible to new sensor types. (ii) The resulting tactile tokens are plug-and-play: they can be seamlessly integrated into policy models across paradigms, from diffusion policy to vision-language-action (VLA) models such as $π_{0.5}$ and LingBot-VLA, consistently enhancing manipulation dexterity. (iii) Extensive experiments, spanning simulation and real-robot deployments across multiple hardware platforms, demonstrate that our tactile representation substantially benefits complex manipulation tasks while maintaining strong computational efficiency. We believe the findings in this work demonstrate the potential of leveraging cross-sensor data to scale tactile learning, and offer encouraging insights for the design of future hardware and embodied models.

papers.title_en: Click3R: Interactive Stereo 3D Reconstruction with Sparse Correspondence Clicks
papers.authors: Hao Gu, Jin Yao, Zezhou Cheng
papers.evidence: 利用稀疏对应点击改进前馈三维重建
papers.tldr: 现有前馈式大规模三维重建模型通常只输出一次性结果，发生误匹配或几何错误后难以修正。Click3R利用用户提供的少量跨视角对应点，将稀疏几何约束注入重建网络，针对重复纹理、对称结构、大视角变化和无纹理区域进行交互式纠错。作者还构建了专门暴露前馈模型失效模式的挑战性基准。实验表明，仅需一次对应点点击即可降低重建误差，并在标准与新基准上提升性能，体现了稀疏人工交互的实用价值。
papers.abstract_en: Despite impressive progress, existing feed-forward large 3D reconstruction models produce a single, irrevocable prediction. When these models fail, there is no mechanism to correct their mistakes. To address this limitation, we introduce Click3R, a framework for interactive geometric correction of feed-forward models using sparse human correspondence clicks. Given an image pair and a small set of cross-view point correspondences provided by a user, Click3R injects geometric constraints into the 3D reconstruction networks through a lightweight point correspondence adapter, enabling the model to resolve ambiguities in challenging scenarios such as repetitive textures, symmetric structures, large viewpoint changes, or textureless regions. To evaluate interactive reconstruction, we curate a challenging benchmark specifically designed to expose failure modes of existing feed-forward 3D reconstruction methods. Experiments show that Click3R reduces reconstruction error with as few as a single correspondence click, improving performance on both standard and our curated benchmarks. Our results highlight that sparse human interaction provides an effective and practical mechanism for correcting geometric reconstruction errors.

papers.title_en: World In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot Manipulation
papers.authors: Heng Fang, Zehui Guo, Yuehan Zhang, Mingyang Du, Dingkang Liang, Xiang Bai
papers.evidence: 通过世界反馈演练示范的上下文机器人操作学习
papers.tldr: 传统机器人操作策略将技能写入网络参数，难以脱离训练分布迁移；仅靠上下文示范又缺少当前世界反馈，性能受限。论文提出世界上下文学习，让冻结模型从单次示范出发，在仿真世界中反复演练，并将反馈写入任务记忆而非权重。RoboScript在RoboTwin 2.0全部50项任务上以每项一次示范、零梯度更新取得83.4%平均成功率，较最强训练策略高20个百分点以上。方法还能借助反思、视觉分布变化及跨具身适配迁移到真实双臂机器人，展示了世界在回路中的上下文学习潜力。
papers.abstract_en: Trained action policies write manipulation skill into network weights, tying what is learned to the distribution it is learned from. In-context learning (ICL) avoids this coupling but has not matched trained policies, because a demonstration recorded in another scene carries no feedback from the world the robot currently faces. We observe that what an agent learns in context is semantic, recording task steps and object roles rather than visual appearance, so experience gathered in one world transfers to another. Based on this insight, we propose World In-Context Learning (WICL), a paradigm in which a frozen model starts from a demonstration, rehearses the task in a world such as a simulator, and writes the feedback into its context rather than its weights. We build RoboScript, a modular infrastructure that implements WICL for agentic manipulation. From a single demonstration, RoboScript learns each task through rehearsal in simulation, freezes the learned knowledge as a Task Memory, and deploys the frozen memory on new scenes with data isolation that ensures every deployment input is available on a real robot. On all 50 tasks of RoboTwin 2.0, RoboScript reaches 83.4% mean success across clean and randomized settings with one demonstration per task and no gradient updates, exceeding the strongest trained action policy by over 20 points. The method generalizes across visual distributions, improves through reflection, scales with the foundation model, and transfers to a physical dual-arm robot through cross-embodiment memory adaptation. With a world in the loop, a robot can learn a manipulation task in its context as well as it learns one in its weights. All code is available at https://github.com/ArcheOne-AI/RoboScript

papers.title_en: OmniLatent: Unified Latent for 3D Part Modeling
papers.authors: Yunhan Yang, Yunfei Zhao, Zeqiang Lai, Jiachen Xu, Minxiu Wang, Xintong Han, Xiangyu Yue, Xihui Liu, Chunchao Guo
papers.evidence: 从单幅图像联合生成三维资产并分解表面部件
papers.tldr: 三维部件分解是可编辑资产创建的基础，但后处理式网格分割易受几何伪影、纹理歧义和部件标注稀缺影响。OmniLatent学习统一潜空间，联合编码几何、形变、外观与二值部件ID，从单张图像一次生成带部件信息的三维资产。基于预训练模型，方法还支持点提示分割、细化、部件细分及遮挡部件补全。实验表明其边界精准、语义合理，并能在交互编辑和不完整观测下保持整体一致性，提升部件建模的统一性与实用性。
papers.abstract_en: 3D part decomposition is a central capability for editable asset creation, yet existing workflows typically segment a completed mesh as a post-processing step, making the result sensitive to geometric artifacts, texture ambiguity, and limited part-level annotations. We present OmniLatent, a unified latent modeling framework for 3D part decomposition. Instead of predicting part labels in isolation, OmniLatent learns a shared latent space that jointly encodes geometry, deformation, appearance, and binary part IDs, allowing data-rich geometric and visual priors to support data-scarce part learning. Given a single input image, the base model generates geometry, deformation, texture, and surface part IDs in one pass, producing a part-aware 3D asset without a separate segmentation stage. We further tune the pretrained model for two extensions: a point-prompt adapter that maps arbitrary 3D point prompts with binary part IDs into latent tokens for full segmentation, refinement, and part subdivision, and an amodal part completion model that completes partial surface masks into a coherent full-object decomposition through dynamic per-part token allocation, cross-attention to the given geometry latent, and alternating part-local and global attention. Extensive experiments show that OmniLatent produces semantically meaningful part segmentations with precise boundaries, supports interactive part editing, and completes partial part observations while preserving global object consistency.

papers.title_en: ForeAct: Geometry-Guided Action Learning from World Representations
papers.authors: Wei Lu, Jiaxi Zhang, Yunheng Wang, Taowen Wang, Yuetong Fang, Zhenhui Zhang, Shuning Zhang, Zizhao Yuan, Yixiao Feng, Zecui Zeng, Renjing Xu
papers.evidence: 面向机器人交互后果预测的几何感知世界表征
papers.tldr: 机器人操作既要理解场景几何，也要预测交互中的空间变化，但现有世界动作模型推理昂贵且缺乏显式空间结构，几何策略又难以预见未来。ForeAct将预训练视频世界模型改造成单次前向的表征骨干，以当前观测的干净潜变量生成动作，并用下一帧相对深度监督可学习令牌，通过双向自注意力塑造共享时空表征。训练后移除几何读出模块，无需深度输入或额外几何骨干。在LIBERO、SimplerEnv-Bridge及真实机器人实验中分别达到96.6%、63.5%和74.4%，实现低延迟、具未来几何感知的控制。
papers.abstract_en: Robotic manipulation requires representations that capture both scene geometry and its evolution during interaction. Existing approaches have largely treated these two aspects separately. World action models capture such dynamics by coupling action prediction with future video generation, but their reliance on iterative diffusion or rectified-flow inference leads to high computational cost, while their representations lack explicit spatial structure. Explicitly modeling scene geometry typically requires auxiliary modules that increase both parameter count and computational cost. Conversely, geometry-centric policies primarily recover observed spatial structure and often lack explicit supervision for anticipating future geometric changes during interaction. To address these limitations, we introduce ForeAct, which repurposes a pretrained video world model as a single-pass representation backbone for low-latency control. ForeAct directly processes the clean latent of the current observation in one forward pass, eliminating future-frame synthesis and iterative denoising while retaining the backbone's pretrained spatiotemporal priors. Rather than introducing a separate geometry backbone, ForeAct uses learnable tokens supervised by next-frame relative depth to shape the shared video representation through bidirectional self-attention. This compact interface turns the spatial knowledge already encoded in the backbone into a future-aware representation for action generation, with little parameter overhead. The lightweight geometry readout is used only during training and removed at deployment, enabling low-latency, geometry-aware control without depth input or an external geometry backbone. Without additional large-scale pretraining, ForeAct achieves 96.6% average success on LIBERO, 63.5% on SimplerEnv-Bridge, and a 74.4% success rate across 90 real-world rollouts.

papers.title_en: PAIR: Proprioception-Aligned Image-Ray Representations for Viewpoint-Robust Manipulation
papers.authors: Sung-Wook Lee, Xuhui Kang, Dylan Losey, Yen-Ling Kuo
papers.evidence: 提升机器人操作视角鲁棒性的视觉表征
papers.tldr: 机器人模仿学习虽可通过规模化提升泛化，但视觉输入在相机视角变化下存在外观与任务状态纠缠，导致策略难以适应未见视角。PAIR利用机器人本体感知，将跨视角且关节状态相近的图像—相机射线联合表征拉近，以对比学习获得视角鲁棒特征。该框架可用于训练Diffusion Policy或后训练视觉语言动作模型，在仿真和真实操作基准上较无射线条件行为克隆分别提升12.7和26.7个百分点，验证了其通用性。
papers.abstract_en: While imitation learning has made substantial progress toward generalizable robot manipulation through scaling, viewpoint robustness remains a major bottleneck. Visuomotor policies rely heavily on visual inputs, yet images provide an inherently ambiguous signal under viewpoint change: similar scenes may appear markedly different across viewpoints, while distinct states may share certain visual overlaps. A policy must therefore infer not only the task-relevant state, but also how it is visually projected under a particular camera configuration. This entanglement of viewpoint-dependent appearance and task-relevant state can make learning inefficient and limit generalization to unseen viewpoints. Recent work has begun to address this challenge through camera-ray conditioning and representation learning using geometric cues to induce invariance. However, providing camera information as additional context does not by itself ground visual representations in how the task scene is visually projected, while geometric alignment without camera context can introduce spurious correspondences by ignoring viewpoint-dependent projection. We propose PAIR, a contrastive learning framework that aligns joint image-ray representations using robot proprioception. PAIR encourages observations with similar robot states to remain close in representation space across viewpoints, providing a structured grounding signal for learning viewpoint-robust features. PAIR is a highly adaptable framework: it can be used to train Diffusion Policy (DP) or post-train vision-language-action (VLA) models. In simulated and real-world manipulation benchmarks with camera variation, PAIR consistently outperforms the behavior cloning baseline without ray conditioning by 12.7% and 26.7% points, respectively, demonstrating stronger generalization to unseen viewpoints. Project website: PAIRrobot.github.io.

papers.title_en: Rethinking Asymmetry in Self-Supervised 3D Geometry Learning
papers.authors: Gyeongjin Kang, Freeman Cheng, Botao Ye, Weijie Lyu, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Eunbyung Park
